name: Bauernhof Angererhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Angererhof in Bad Häring is a traditional Tyrolean farmhouse inn that combines active agriculture with warm hospitality and home-style dining. It offers guests an authentic glimpse into rural Alpine life. The on-site restaurant serves delicious regional products and local specialities. The picturesque surrounding landscape invites visitors to enjoy scenic hiking and cycling tours. In addition, Bad Häring is renowned for its therapeutic thermal springs, making the Angererhof a wonderful base for both relaxation and outdoor adventures.
